ModulePrefs.title: e_periodic
ModulePrefs.author: Juan M. Aguirregabiria (http://tp.lc.ehu.es/jma.html); Fremont Teng; Loo Kang Wee
ModulePrefs.description: N equal masses are moving in the same plane under the action of the mutual gravitational attraction. If the initial conditions are chosen in the right way, some periodic solutions of a very special kind may be found: all particles move along the same orbit and the total angular momentum vanishes in the center-of-mass system. One can see some examples in this simulation.
